daemon_env_exposure.note: inherent to `docker --env`: the daemon records Config.Env with values, so any local caller who can query it can read an injected variable. This project persists no inspect blob; the exposure is stated, not claimed closed. Closing it needs a secrets mount, which is out of P4.5 scope.
